accepted.initial_audience: Small SaaS teams collecting customer feedback
accepted.example_prompt: Create a feedback form asking about satisfaction, missing features, and permission to follow up.
accepted.creation: Natural-language prompts with a form preview

ai_roles.text_generation: Draft questions, descriptions, answer options, and requested edits
ai_roles.jev: Select controls and presentation from a supplied component catalogue

editing: Direct controls for wording, options, and required status

publishing.respondent_experience: Fixed published form version rather than an AI-generated interview for each respondent
publishing.updates: Save edits as a draft and require explicit Publish update
publishing.historical_submissions: Retain the original question wording and form version
publishing.in_progress_sessions: Respondents finish the version they opened; new visitors receive latest publication

distribution.proprietary_generation_instructions: Private server-side environment configuration; actual instructions excluded from public source and example configuration
distribution.starter_instructions: Functional generic public starter prompt, replaceable by self-hosters
distribution.self_hosted_keys: Operator supplies text-generation and Jev API keys

hosted_service.ai_usage: 20 AI operations per verified account per UTC day, enforced on the server
hosted_service.public_submissions: No AI calls during respondent form completion or submission

form_features.branching: Simple configured conditional visibility based on another answer

ai_edit_review.review: Preview and change summary with Apply or Discard
ai_edit_review.undo: Available after applying an AI edit
ai_edit_review.unsupported_requests: Explain limitation and offer supported alternative

accepted.ownership: One owner per form in the initial release

form_lifecycle.closure: Stops submissions across versions and displays a clear message at the public link
form_lifecycle.permanent_form_deletion: Requires explicit confirmation and removes form submissions

text_generation.output: Structured form definitions and edits checked by application validation
text_generation.configuration: Model ID configurable through server environment

jev.scope: Choose controls/presentation from a supported form catalogue

hosted_allowances.failed_operation: No daily allowance consumed when no valid edit proposal is produced; failed attempts still rate limited
hosted_allowances.successful_proposal: Consumes one operation even if discarded
hosted_allowances.operator_controls: Configurable request/token bounds, global daily AI spend cutoff, and request rate limits
hosted_allowances.semantics: Server-side enforcement; public submissions and manual editing do not consume AI operations

postdrop.billing: No billing in current operations documentation
postdrop.authentication: Auth.js Credentials email/password; also supports Google
postdrop.ai_prompt_pattern: No existing AI prompt configuration found

deployment_inputs: OpenAI and TypeSafe account access and keys
Required analytics and error-reporting service configuration
